scope: Exact original SDK lookup output for the declared account list and configured entities
limits: This measures SDK-map parity; it does not certify all enterprise accounts or unassigned role definitions.
Resolved data policies and real consumer authentication, logout, token renewal, and allowed/denied journeys need separate evidence.
A completeness declaration records operator input; it does not authenticate its business authority.
gaps: Complete role definitions beyond assigned accounts remain outside this measurement.
Resolved data restrictions are not returned by either SDK map.
Downstream business journeys are not executed by this command.
populationSource: Built-in synthetic fixture population; not enterprise users
